zh-CN.title: 孔颖达
zh-CN.subtitle: 经学家与《五经正义》编纂者
zh-CN.shortSummary: 孔颖达代表唐代经学如何进入国家教育、注疏和制度化知识生产。
curatorialDescription: 孔颖达的故事不是简单的‘经典解释者’传记，而是文本、注疏者、编纂工程和国家教育制度共同作用的案例。
通过他可以看到，儒家传统如何从经典解释进入官学与政治秩序，同时保留内部注释差异和历史语境。
zh-CN.researchNote: 本条目为 Alpha 结构化样本，后续需要补充编纂参与者、版本流传和国子监使用语境的来源。

en.title: Kong Yingda
en.subtitle: Classical scholar and compiler associated with the Corrected Meanings of the Five Classics
en.shortSummary: Kong Yingda represents how Tang classical learning entered state education, commentary and institutional knowledge production.
curatorialDescription: Kong Yingda is not simply a biographical ‘interpreter of classics’. His case brings texts, commentators, editorial projects and state education into the same frame.
Through him we can see how Confucian traditions moved from textual interpretation into official learning and political order while retaining internal differences and historical context.
